policies: Morbid Swarm uses two real Choose One branches and the existing explicit combined branch. Ants use genuine attributed fixed summons; Bug Bites pays a full2 Corpses then deals4 SPELL damage to its accepted minion. Low balance skips the damage without a partial spend; normal mana/target legality still applies. Combined order is Ants then payment/damage, using the live balance after summon reactions. These low-balance/combined notification windows remain M6.

The two genuine child spells retain their physical printed1-mana faces and standalone executable bodies; they are not invented choice-only markers. Ant Husk is Beast/Undead and contributes one corpse by default.

Falric installs a removable printed corpse-gain source through the normal lifecycle. All actual positive corpse gains use the product of active source multipliers at credit; zero bases stay zero. Death batches are removed before credits, so dead providers do not multiply the batch. Base corpse_value remains intrinsic; published gain amount is the actual credit. Stacking and simultaneous-death policy remain M6.

Falric draws from the complete frozen CORPSE_SPENDER-tagged source membership, intersected with actual physical deck faces at the original body window. No generation inventory is truncated by implementation status; unknown actual physical cards already fail explicitly. An empty matching deck skips without fatigue. This is a physical draw, not generation.

Reanimate the Terror advances by actual committed friendly resource_spent corpse amounts from existing fixed, capped or cost-payment records. Failed/zero/other-player spend does not progress. Actual15 completion delivers the real Tyrax to hand through the existing quest reward pipeline; full hand burns normally.

Tyrax opens the real two-durability Terror grave at its original death position. Grave deals4 EFFECT damage to a character, uses ordinary location cooldown/durability, and its real Deathrattle resummons Tyrax through attributed summon machinery. Fixed dependency loop is fully present. Exact death/position/full-board behavior remains M6.

Thalena first installs the fixed Vampyr Kiss as an independent second hero power; the primary is preserved. Kiss natively costs3 CORPSES, independently tracks normal uses and grants3 Attack to a minion without treating it as a spell. A pre-existing additional hero power, including repeated Thalena, is explicitly unsupported pending actual second-slot replacement/refresh evidence; do not silently create a third power or guess refresh rules.
